evidence: Vaporpphase ALD of Co 9S 8 thin films was carried out in a homepbuilt ALD reactor by using bis( N,N’ pdiisopropylacetamidinato)cobalt(II) (Co(amd) 2) vapor as the cobalt precursor and H2S (1%) as the copreactant gas. During the deposition, the cobalt precursor was heated to 60 °C, and was delivered into the reactor chamber with the assist of N 2 carrier gas.
